newsitem.title: KENYA: Coffee prices seen lower at Kenya auction.
newsitem.headline: Coffee prices seen lower at Kenya auction.

text.p: Coffee prices were lower at the weekly export auction on Tuesday with medium and lower qualities declining by around $3, traders said.
Premium grades AAs averaged $129 per 50 kg bag compared to $133 last week, ABs eased to $119.5 from $124 and grade Cs fell to 119.5 from $122.
"The better quality (coffee) held steady with good demand for AA grade. Medium and lower quality were $3 lower," a coffee official said. "The market average price was $109.07.
The Coffee Board of Kenya sold 40,804 bags of 60-kg each from 40,874 on offer. Last week 40,500 bags were sold.
